text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? The review meeting... if I remember 
correctly—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"—This project will have an evaluation 
meeting every six months!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
This evaluation directly impacts our 
support amount! Therefore, I want us to 
draft and execute construction plans 
continuously for this purpose!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't you the one who said that?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Right! To give you a quick summary—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The VIPs supporting this project are 
coming to this island!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I want to see if things are going 
according to plan and turning out well!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And so, that's how it'll be decided how 
much support we get for the next 
half-year, right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, if things don't go smoothly, support 
gets cut...? Ugh, that's... pretty harsh.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dahaha! No worries! As long as it's 
proceeding according to the construction 
plan we set, there's no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Besides, there's nothing more you can do 
now! Stand tall, puff out your chest, and 
hold your ground!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, we can at least do some cleaning 
up! Come on, let's all fix it up a bit 
together!"

And so, the 1st Tracen Island Evaluation 
Meeting began!
